name: wecom-autoreply
description: Opt-in, macOS: a resident WeCom (企业微信) AI bot whose replies are written by headless Claude Code, and which types the owner's messages into a Claude Code terminal on the Mac, pushing each reply back to WeCom. Includes wecom-cli setup and a launchd agent. The bot itself requires Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: WeCom AI bot answered by Claude Code, kept alive by launchd.
interface.longDescription: Sets up a resident WeCom AI bot on macOS: replies come from headless, tool-less Claude Code; requests for the owner become numbered to-dos pushed to WeCom; the owner's own messages go into a Claude Code terminal on the Mac (tmux, with tools), with each reply pushed back to WeCom. Includes wecom-cli installation and a launchd agent. The bot itself requires Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Set up my WeCom bot to auto-reply with Claude Code.
My WeCom bot stopped replying — check it.
